free_tier.stated: Free: 1 GB storage, 200 GB/month bandwidth, WebDAV and API on Free (WebDAV is listed on the Supporter table as a Free-tier feature).

egress.terms: Free plan includes a 200 GB per month soft bandwidth cap (~6.6 GB per day). Terms state: 'Don't worry—these are soft limits. Temporary surges are fine, we won't take your site down automatically'.

record.tooling: Documented REST API: POST /api/upload (multipart, Bearer API key), plus WebDAV and an official CLI; rclone has no neocities backend but the WebDAV mount covers it.
record.chaining: 1 GB per site x unlimited sites per account ('Multiple Site Creation' is listed as a free feature) x unlimited free accounts. 20 TiB = 20,480 sites. Operationally absurd, so this only works as a shard for a small hot set, not the archive.
record.limits_note: 1 GB per site on Free (50 GB Supporter); 200 GB/month bandwidth on Free; file-type restrictions on Free (no arbitrary binary types. 'No File Upload Type Restrictions' is a Supporter-only row); API requires a key per site.
record.reliability_note: Bandwidth is internally enforced and will throttle, not delete; static file serving goes through Cloudflare with a 300s edge cache.

evidence.proved: plan table: 'Storage 1 GB / 50 GB', 'Bandwidth 200 GB / 3000 GB', WebDAV listed under Supporter-only features
